### Demons and Idols
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/demons-and-idols
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:19-22
Points:
- Although pagan deities have no actual existence, sacrifices made to them are offered to real demons.
- Non-Christian religions, whether monotheistic or polytheistic, are rooted in demonic deception rather than the true God.
- Sharing in the Lord's table establishes fellowship with Christ, making participation in pagan rituals or interfaith worship impossible.
- Joining in religious rites with other faiths provokes the Lord's jealousy and constitutes spiritual idolatry.
- Christian witness and evangelism require prayer against the spiritual powers enslaving people in false religions.

### A Prayer for Not Being Idle about Our Idols
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/a-prayer-for-not-being-idle-about-our-idols/
Passage: 1 Corinthians 10:14
Points:
- Obeying the call to flee idolatry requires looking past physical images to the invisible idols of the heart.
- Common modern idols include craving human approval, insisting on always being right, and needing control over circumstances.
- Believers still face internal battles where secondary things demand the adoration belonging solely to God.
- The power of idolatry weakens when the beauty and love of Christ captivate the soul.
- Resting in the gospel and our secure identity as God's children motivates us to dethrone every false master.
